description: Defines an enum PaymentAllocationTransactionType representing various types of loan transaction payment allocations, each associated with a LoanTransactionType and a human-readable name. Includes utility methods to retrieve enum options as a list and check if the type is default.

classes.name: PaymentAllocationTransactionType
classes.description: Enum representing different types of payment allocations for loan transactions, with associated transaction types and display names.

methods.name: getValuesAsEnumOptionDataList
methods.description: Returns a list of EnumOptionData objects representing each enum value with ordinal, name, and human-readable name.

methods.name: isDefault
methods.description: Checks if the enum instance is the DEFAULT type.
